scripts.dev:all: npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.lint: npm -w apps/frontend run lint && npm -w apps/backend run lint
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.test: npm -w apps/frontend test && npm -w apps/backend test
scripts.test:all: npm -w apps/frontend test -- --run && npm -w apps/backend test -- --run && npm -w apps/frontend run test:e2e
scripts.setup: npm install && cd apps/backend && npx prisma generate
scripts.migrate: cd apps/backend && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:reset: cd apps/backend && npx prisma migrate reset
